name: WordLyrics
author: moshi
description: Native word timing, lyric repair and private drafts. New downloads use the mode below. Requires the separately installed WordLyrics backend; audio stays unchanged.

settings.label: New songs: word timing
settings.description: Applied to every new download and newly added local song. Off skips automatic timing; manual repair remains available. Medium keeps the previous Half setting. Changes affect the next batch.

settings.label: Say when a song is done
settings.description: A short notification each time a song's word timing is finished.

settings.label: WordLyrics folder
settings.description: Leave empty for the usual place: the WordLyrics folder in your user folder.

settings.label: Backup folder
settings.description: WordLyrics keeps a copy of every song before it works on it. Leave empty for the usual place: a "WordLyrics Backups" folder on the drive with the most free space.

settings.label: Set up WordLyrics…
settings.description: Opens a confirmation before setup downloads anything. The two models need about 1.33 GB, plus Python and packages; existing components are reused. Cancel keeps queued songs and existing lyrics.

settings.label: Show timing status
settings.description: Show stages in Noctis notifications. Open progress below for pause, stop and details; background work never takes keyboard focus.

settings.label: Open timing progress…
settings.description: Open native progress, pause/resume, stop and the latest result.

settings.label: Time library songs…
settings.description: Open the native folder picker to time missing words. Existing word timing is kept; a large batch asks before starting.
